title: Permission profile
description: What one peer may do on this machine. Defined and stored by the receiving machine; never sent by the requester.

roots.description: Absolute folders that auto mode may use without prompting. Ignored in ask mode (every access prompts).

extra_deny.description: Additional glob patterns that are always denied, on top of the built-in hard deny list.

out_of_scope.description: What auto mode does for an action outside the scope. Default: ask.

remember.description: never: every action prompts. session: an approval 'for this session' is remembered until the session closes.

expires_at.description: When this profile stops applying (auto mode then behaves as ask). Required for auto mode; null means no expiry and must be written explicitly.
